description: Gate-only params.json for the SBOM sign stage. Runs only when SIGN_ARTIFACTS and CREATE_SBOM are both true. SIGN_ARTIFACTS is defined in 03-internal-code-sign.params.json.

parameterGroups.name: Stage Selections
parameterGroups.description: Boolean flags that control which pipeline stages are enabled. All stage-gate parameters are collected here so operators can see and adjust the full execution plan in one place.

parameters.name: CREATE_SBOM
parameters.description: Generate a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) during the build stage, and run the SBOM sign and validate-SBOM stages. Enabled by default.
